Brand marks

Pick the cards that feel like the real apps.

Three directions per app, each built from that app's published design system (Material 3 for Gmail and Maps, Uber's Base, GitHub's Primer), plus five short-lived components an agent could show mid-turn. All data is demo data. Every card animates; press Replay to watch it again, and click around: the rides, steps, checks and buttons respond.

Uber Move is Uber's private typeface, so Uber cards use Inter as a stand-in. Official marks are shown for exploration; T3 Code currently ships monogram tiles (toggle at the top).

  1. Star one favorite per app (blue ring).
  2. Heart anything else worth keeping, including the ephemeral ideas.
  3. Press Copy picks and paste them back to me. Picks are saved in this browser and in the page link.

Ephemeral components

Short-lived UI an agent shows during a turn, picked for a UX job: keep you oriented while it works, slow you down before something consequential, and always leave a way back.
1Live activity pill
UberUMarcus · arriving 3
7ABC123
Pickup at the Ferry Building
Open in Uber
Ask anything, or type / for skills
t3codeLocalarrow_upward

Job: stay oriented while you keep working. A Dynamic-Island-style capsule docks above the composer for anything that keeps happening after the turn (ride, deploy, CI). The ring drains with the ETA; tap to expand, it dismisses itself on arrival.

2Hold to confirm
UberX · Ferry Building → SFO · $38.40
touch_appHold to request UberX
Requested in Uber
Marcus is 4 min away · Cancel

Job: make consequential actions deliberate. When cards stop being read-only (RFC #70), booking, sending or merging needs a 1.2 s press. Letting go early rewinds the fill; finishing draws a check and offers Cancel right away.

Job: show parallel work honestly. Today the live row only shows the newest call when an agent fans out. Each app gets its own row with a real timer; when all finish they fold into one chip you can reopen.

Job: a way back. A Material snackbar with a draining bar for any reversible action the agent takes. Five seconds to undo, then the bar is gone, which is the moment it becomes final.

5Just-in-time permission
MThe agent wants to use Gmail
Let this turn read your Gmail?
check_circleSearch and read messages
check_circleSee attachments' names
blockSend, delete or archive (not requested)
MGmail · read access for this turn Revoke

Job: consent at the moment of need. Asked only when a tool first needs an app, scoped to what the tool does, defaulting to this turn. It shrinks into a chip with Revoke, so there is always a way out.

Concept boards

Made with ChatGPT image generation as a mood check before building. Ideas taken: Uber's map-topped sheet and black Request bar, Gmail's list-plus-open-message with an AI summary chip, the CI timeline and merged pill for GitHub.
